title: Lithos Note Schema
description: Defines the format of a Lithos note schema file. A note schema describes the frontmatter properties expected on a type of markdown note in the vault. Properties may be defined inline or referenced from the property bank using '$ref: property_bank#/<name>'. Schemas may extend a parent schema and exclude inherited properties they don't need.

$version.title: Schema Version
$version.description: The version of the Lithos schema format this file uses. Optional - defaults to '1.0' if not specified. Used for migration and compatibility checking when upgrading to future versions.

name.title: Schema Name (Deprecated)
name.description: DEPRECATED: The schema name is now derived from the filename (without extension). This field is ignored if present. For backward compatibility, if provided, it must match the filename. Will be removed in a future version.

properties.title: Property Definitions
properties.description: The properties defined or overridden by this schema. Each key is the frontmatter field name as it appears in the note. Each value is either an inline property definition or a property bank reference (with optional overrides). Properties inherited from a parent schema via 'extends' do not need to be listed here unless they are being overridden.

propertyNames.description: Property names must start with a letter (uppercase or lowercase) or underscore, and may contain letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens.

extends.title: Parent Schema
extends.description: The name of a parent schema whose properties this schema inherits. The child schema receives all properties from the parent, minus any listed in 'excludes', plus the properties defined in this schema's own 'properties' map. Overriding an inherited property is done by re-defining it in 'properties'.

excludes.title: Excluded Inherited Properties
excludes.description: A list of property names inherited from the parent schema (via 'extends') that this schema does not use. These properties will not appear in notes using this schema. Only valid when 'extends' is also set.

Property.title: Property
Property.description: A single property entry in a schema's 'properties' map. May be either an inline definition of the property's type and constraints, or a reference to a named property in the property bank (with optional override fields).

oneOf.title: Property Bank Reference
oneOf.description: Reference a property from the property bank. The '$ref' resolves the property definition, then any additional fields (like 'required', 'multi', 'options') override the defaults from the bank.

oneOf.title: Inline Property Definition
oneOf.description: Define this property's type and constraints directly in the schema. Requires a 'type' field.

PropertyBankRef.title: Property Bank Reference with Overrides
PropertyBankRef.description: A reference to a named property in the vault's property bank, with optional override fields. The '$ref' field is required and must follow the format 'property_bank#/<name>'. Any additional fields (required, multi, type, options, etc.) override the defaults from the referenced property. This allows schemas to reuse property definitions while customizing constraints.

$ref.title: Property Bank Reference Path
$ref.description: Must follow the format 'property_bank#/<name>' where <name> is the exact key of a property defined in the vault's property_bank.json file.

required.title: Required
required.description: Whether this property must be present in every note using this schema. Defaults to false. This field is only valid in schemas, not in the property bank.

multi.title: Multiple Values
multi.description: Override whether this property holds multiple values. If not specified, uses the value from the property bank.

type.title: Property Type Override
type.description: Override the property type. If specified, replaces the type from the property bank. Use with caution — changing type fundamentally changes the property.

options.title: Allowed Values Override
options.description: Override the allowed values for a string property. If specified, replaces the options from the property bank.

pattern.title: Validation Pattern Override
pattern.description: Override the regex pattern for a string property.

step.title: Step Override
step.description: Override the step value for a number property.

min.title: Minimum Override
min.description: Override the minimum value for a number property.

max.title: Maximum Override
max.description: Override the maximum value for a number property.

format.title: Date Format Override
format.description: Override the format for a date property.

directory.title: Target Directory Override
directory.description: Override the directory constraint for a file property.

file_class.title: Required Schema Override
file_class.description: Override the required schema for a file property.

PropertyDefinition.title: Inline Property Definition
PropertyDefinition.description: A full definition of a property's type and constraints, written directly in the schema file. Requires a 'type' field.

CommonFields.description: Fields shared across all property types in inline definitions.

required.title: Required
required.description: Whether this property must be present in every note using this schema. Defaults to false.

multi.title: Multiple Values
multi.description: Whether this property holds multiple values (a list) rather than a single value. Defaults to false.

StringProperty.title: String Property
StringProperty.description: A property that holds a text value. Optionally constrained to a fixed set of allowed values via 'options', or validated against a regular expression via 'pattern'.

options.title: Allowed Values
options.description: Constrains the property to a fixed set of values. Supports three modes: (1) a plain array of strings when order is unimportant; (2) an object mapping position integers to values for explicit display order; (3) an array of objects with value, optional label, and optional order for cases where the stored value differs from display text.

oneOf.title: Plain Value List
oneOf.description: An unordered set of allowed string values. Use when display order is unimportant or alphabetical order is acceptable. Example: ["education", "personal", "professional"]

oneOf.title: Ordered Value Map
oneOf.description: An object where each key is a positive integer string (1-indexed) encoding display position and the value is the stored string. Use when order has semantic meaning (workflow states, priority levels). Example: {"1": "to_do", "2": "in_progress", "3": "done"}

oneOf.title: Value with Labels
oneOf.description: An array of objects where each item has a 'value' (required), optional 'label' for display, and optional 'order' for explicit positioning. Use when stored values differ from display text. If 'order' is omitted, array position defines display order. Example: [{"value": "january", "label": "January"}, {"value": "february", "label": "February"}]

value.title: Stored Value
value.description: The value stored in the note's frontmatter.

label.title: Display Label
label.description: Human-readable text shown in UI. If omitted, 'value' is used for display.

order.title: Display Order
order.description: Explicit position for display sorting. Use for sparse numbering (10, 20, 30) to leave room for insertions. If omitted, array position defines order.

pattern.title: Validation Pattern
pattern.description: A regular expression the property value must match.

NumberProperty.title: Number Property
NumberProperty.description: A property that holds a numeric value (integer or float). Optionally constrained by minimum, maximum, and step values.

step.title: Step
step.description: The increment/decrement step for UI controls. For example, 1.0 means whole numbers only.

min.title: Minimum Value
min.description: The minimum allowed value (inclusive). Note: JSON Schema cannot enforce that min < max; this constraint is validated at runtime by Lithos.

max.title: Maximum Value
max.description: The maximum allowed value (inclusive). Note: JSON Schema cannot enforce that min < max; this constraint is validated at runtime by Lithos.

BooleanProperty.title: Boolean Property
BooleanProperty.description: A property that holds a true/false value.

DateProperty.title: Date Property
DateProperty.description: A property that holds a date, time, or datetime value. The format string uses strftime notation: '%Y-%m-%d' for ISO dates, '%H:%M' for times, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M' for local datetimes.

format.title: Date Format
format.description: The display and parsing format for this date field, using strftime notation. Common formats: '%Y-%m-%d' (ISO date), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M' (local datetime), '%Y' (year only), '%H:%M' (time only).

FileProperty.title: File Reference Property
FileProperty.description: A property that links to one or more other notes in the vault, identified by file path. Use 'directory' to restrict which vault folder(s) are valid targets. Use 'file_class' to require the linked note to have a specific schema.

directory.title: Target Directory
directory.description: A vault-relative path (or regex-style alternation of paths) specifying where valid link targets must reside. Use parentheses and pipe for alternatives, e.g. '(41_personal|42_education)/'. A trailing slash is required.

file_class.title: Required Schema
file_class.description: The name of the schema that the linked note must use. This constrains link targets to notes of a specific type.
